driver: experiments/repro_second_lane_k10.py (new file; does NOT import the original k10_cue_indexed_adapter.py)
expectation: B1 reproduces 3-4/4 wins (WIN verdict); B2 reproduces 0-1/4 gaps (no-gap control).
gate_control_B2: Per seed: GAP iff R >= 1.30. Control replicates (no gap) iff gaps <= 1/4 (no-gap on >= 3/4). CONFOUND iff gaps >= 3/4 -> do NOT claim, investigate. 2/4 gaps = INCONCLUSIVE.
gate_main_B1: Original K10 gate applied per seed: WIN iff R >= 1.30. Verdict reproduces (BOUND LIFTED) iff wins >= 3/4; OVERTURNED iff wins <= 1/4; 2/4 = INCONCLUSIVE.
hypothesis: Both K10 verdicts replicate on fresh seeds with an independently written driver: B1 cue-indexed gains beat frozen (bound lifts); B2 control (cue withheld) shows no gap.
lane: second_lane (independent driver, rewritten from the published spec; only the architecture modules under test are imported)
null: One or both K10 verdicts do not replicate (original was a seeding/single-driver artifact, or a module confound). A non-replication in either direction is reported as such.
preregistered_before: any implementation or execution of the second-lane K10 driver

protocol.env: changing_rule v1.0.0 (canonical flesh-pits/experiments/envs/changing_rule.py); rule flips every PHASE_LEN=5 episodes; 10% reward noise
protocol.frozen_condition: identical CueIndexedArbitrator with frozen=True (all context gain vectors pinned at 1.0)
protocol.metric: R = total_reward(learned) / total_reward(frozen) per seed per probe; WIN/GAP iff R >= 1.30

probes.B1_cue_indexed: context_fn = lambda obs: int(obs['cue'])  (cue in the input)
probes.B2_cue_withheld: context_fn = lambda obs: None  (control; constant context)

protocol.specialists: neutral (0.5 + noise(0.05); bandit isolation, same as K5 P4)

reproduction_rule.note: 4-seed adaptation of the >=4/5 rule: 3/4 reproduces a win/lift verdict; <=1/4 reproduces a bound-stands/no-gap verdict.
reproduction_rule.overturns: a probe's verdict reverses (B1 wins <=1/4; B2 gaps >=3/4)
reproduction_rule.reproduces: verdict identity holds per probe (>=3/4 wins on B1; <=1/4 gaps on B2)

seed_disjointness: All four replication seeds are distinct from the original K10 seed set and from every other known flesh-pits seed series.
